intent: Metric 4: semantic models for GitHub daily activity, the release-day breakdown and headline

edits.new_content:
version: 2
semantic_models:
- name: fct_github_daily
  description: 'Metric 4: GitHub activity per UTC day (PRs opened, PRs merged, commits), one row per day
    per activity. Never add counts across activities.'
  model: ref('fct_github_daily')
  defaults:
    agg_time_dimension: activity_date
  entities:
  - name: github_day
    type: primary
    expr: github_day_key
    config: &id001
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  dimensions:
  - name: activity_date
    type: time
    description: UTC day.
    type_params:
      time_granularity: day
    config: *id001
  - name: activity
    type: categorical
    description: prs_opened, prs_merged or commits.
    config: *id001
  - name: activity_label
    type: categorical
    description: PRs opened, PRs merged or Commits.
    config: *id001
  - name: weekday_name
    type: categorical
    description: Day of the week.
    config: *id001
  - name: is_release_day
    type: categorical
    description: True on GTA 6's release day.
    config: *id001
  - name: days_from_release
    type: categorical
    description: Days after release day (negative before).
    config: *id001
  measures:
  - name: github_activity_count_measure
    agg: sum
    expr: activity_count
    description: How many on the day (GitHub Search API total_count).
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: count
          additivity: additive
          null_rule: NULL when unavailable, never zero.

version: 2
semantic_models:
- name: fct_github_release_day_activities
  description: 'Metric 4 breakdown: one row per activity, release day against the same weekday a week
    before (a median over the weeks when more than one).'
  model: ref('fct_github_release_day_activities')
  defaults:
    agg_time_dimension: release_day
  entities:
  - name: github_activity
    type: primary
    expr: activity
    config: &id001
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  dimensions:
  - name: activity
    type: categorical
    description: prs_opened, prs_merged or commits.
    config: *id001
  - name: activity_label
    type: categorical
    description: PRs opened, PRs merged or Commits.
    config: *id001
  - name: release_day
    type: time
    description: GTA 6's release day.
    type_params:
      time_granularity: day
    config: *id001
  - name: baseline_start
    type: time
    description: First baseline day.
    type_params:
      time_granularity: day
    config: *id001
  - name: baseline_end
    type: time
    description: Last baseline day.
    type_params:
      time_granularity: day
    config: *id001
  measures:
  - name: github_activity_pct_change
    agg: max
    expr: pct_change
    description: Release day against the baseline average, in percent.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: percent
          additivity: non_additive
          null_rule: NULL unless release day and every baseline day have a count.
  - name: github_activity_release_day_count
    agg: max
    expr: release_day_count
    description: Count on release day.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: count
          additivity: non_additive
          null_rule: NULL until release day has ended and been counted.
  - name: github_activity_baseline_count
    agg: max
    expr: baseline_count
    description: Count on the baseline day (median over baseline days).
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: count
          additivity: non_additive
          null_rule: NULL when no baseline day has a count.
  config:
    meta:
      dex:
        population:
          rule: One row per activity present in fct_github_daily, whether or not release day has been
            counted yet.
        assumptions:
        - decision: What release day is compared with
          chosen: the same weekday a week before (Thu 12 Nov 2026); a median when github_baseline_weeks
            > 1
          evidence: data
          detail: 'profiled (.dex/review/154): strong weekly cycle, and PRs opened grew from 1.15M (22
            Oct) to 1.35M (12 Nov) on Thursdays, so older weeks understate a normal 19 Nov; commits carry
            bulk-import spikes (16.4M on 5 Nov vs ~12.9M), hence a median for longer baselines. No US
            holiday on 12 Nov'
          column: baseline_count
        - decision: A baseline day without a count
          chosen: change NULL
          evidence: default
          detail: an average over fewer days would be a different baseline
          column: pct_change

version: 2
semantic_models:
- name: fct_github_release_day
  description: 'Metric 4 headline: the average of the activities'' release-day changes, one row per release
    day, with its breakdown.'
  model: ref('fct_github_release_day')
  defaults:
    agg_time_dimension: release_day
  entities:
  - name: github_release_day
    type: primary
    expr: release_day_key
    config: &id001
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  dimensions:
  - name: breakdown
    type: categorical
    description: Every activity's change. Always report it with the headline.
    config: *id001
  - name: release_day
    type: time
    description: GTA 6's release day.
    type_params:
      time_granularity: day
    config: *id001
  - name: baseline_start
    type: time
    description: First baseline day.
    type_params:
      time_granularity: day
    config: *id001
  - name: baseline_end
    type: time
    description: Last baseline day.
    type_params:
      time_granularity: day
    config: *id001
  measures:
  - name: github_release_day_change_measure
    agg: max
    expr: github_release_day_change
    description: Average of the activities' release-day changes, in percent.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: percent
          additivity: non_additive
          null_rule: NULL until every activity has a change.
  config:
    meta:
      dex:
        population:
          rule: One row for the configured release day (var github_release_day).
        assumptions:
        - decision: How the activities combine
          chosen: plain average of the per-activity percent changes
          evidence: precedent
          detail: the Day-Off Index averages its phrases' changes the same way; counts differ by 10x between
            PRs and commits, so changes are averaged, not counts
          column: github_release_day_change
        - decision: An activity not yet available
          chosen: headline NULL
          evidence: precedent
          detail: 'fct_day_off_index: an average over fewer parts is a different number'
          column: github_release_day_change
